docs.title: Introduction
docs.text: • This is the individual website the research, design and development of the Alarm Subsystem in the Smart Door Sensor.

docs.title: Project Summary
docs.text:
• Smart Door Sensor designed to be capable of detection to determine if door is locked, auto-lock and unlock operations, number pad input for added security, and an alarm system to notify users of any issues to be resolved.
  • Project research, design and development documented on the team website.

docs.title: Product Objective and Requirements
docs.text: This project aims to investigate and develop smart adaptive technologies, an improved user experience, better fit, improved product design, and product customization options for the next-generation of home door sensors. This subsystem fulfils requirements stated in Section 2.2 of the team product requirements "The product shall send real-time alerts for door left open, forced entry attempts, and lock tampering".

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Microcontroller Subsystem tasked with Audio-Visual Alarm processes.

docs.title: Components
docs.text:
1. Power Subsystem
  2. Unregulated Power Supply (9V, 3A Wall Adapter) Provides the raw DC voltage needed to power the system.
  3. 5V Voltage Regulator (7805) Converts the 9V supply into a stable, regulated 5V for the PIC microcontroller and analog circuits.

  4. Supports requirements: 5.2 Energy-efficient components Ensures stable operation of low-power digital and analog components in the full system.

  5. Microcontroller (PIC18F57Q43)

  6. Performs logic, I/O control, timing, alarm behavior, and communication.

  7. Supports requirements: 2.2 Real-time alerts (Door Left Open / Tamper Events),5.3 Modular components.

  8. Audio Output Subsystem

  9. Supports requirements: 2.2 Real-time alerts, 3.1 Audio feedback.

  2. ESE-20D441 PushButton Switch

  3. CST10T2CR Relay Switch

Choice: Option 3: CST10T2CR Relay Switch

Rationale: This Relay system built into the switch would allow to control appliances with low power signals. This can be useful in protecting against high voltage passes and other hazardous conditions by safely switching circuits off to prevent damage.

docs.title: Component Summary
docs.text:
• Speaker: Part Number: 4166 Part Passive Buzzer 5V-ND Type: Piezoelectric, 5V Rationale: High efficiency, low price, provides loud and clear sounds even on low-powered setup

  • Relay Switch: Part Number: CST10T2CR Type: Relay-integrated switch Rationale: Controls appliances with low power signals, protects against high voltage and hazardous conditions by safely switching circuits off

  • Operational Amplifier: Part Number: MCP6004-I/P Type: Quad op-amp, single supply voltage Rationale: Provides 4 circuits on one supply voltage, already available to team (zero cost)

  • Voltage Regulator: Part Number: L7805 (4491-L7805-ND) Type: 5V output regulator Rationale: Provides sufficient current to power MCU and all connected peripherals, already available to team

docs.title: Enhanced Audio Output System
docs.text: Upgrade the passive pizzo buzzer to an active buzzer speaker module. This improves sound clarity, increases maximum volume, and enables more flexible tones. Adding a PWM-based volume control will also gives users the ability to adjust loudness based on their environment, making the audio system more adaptable and user-friendly.

docs.title: Microcontroller & Communication Expansion
docs.text: Version 2.0 can integrate plug-in communication modules (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth). This approach keeps the core controller while allowing wireless connectivity. It also enables smartphone integration and remote control features without redesigning the entire board.

docs.title: Improved Diagnostics & LED Feedback
docs.text: Include multiple debugging LEDs throughout the system to represent power status, state, sensor activity, communication status, and fault indicators. These LEDs provide instant visual confirmation of each subsystem’s behavior, greatly simplifying testing and troubleshooting.

docs.title: Modular System Architecture
docs.text: Adopt a modular layout where major functions like power supply, audio output, relay , sensors, and communication modules are designed as separate blocks with standardized connectors. This makes it easier to isolate issues, upgrade individual components, and perform testing without affecting the entire design.
